divinity.name: Divinity
divinity.tooltipTemplate: Increases all healing done by you and all healing effects on you by [V1]%.

stoicism.name: Stoicism
stoicism.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the duration of all Stun effects by an additional [V1]% and reduces the chance your helpful spells and damage over time effects will be dispelled by an additional [V2]%.

guardians_favor.name: Guardian's Favor
guardians_favor.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Hand of Protection by 2 min and increases the duration of your Hand of Freedom by 4 sec.

anticipation.name: Anticipation
anticipation.tooltipTemplate: Increases your chance to dodge by [V1]%.

divine_sacrifice.name: Divine Sacrifice
divine_sacrifice.tooltipTemplate: 30% of all damage taken by party members within 30 yards is redirected to the Paladin (up to a maximum of 40% of the Paladin's health times the number of party members).  Damage which reduces the Paladin below 20% health will break the effect.  Lasts 10 sec.

improved_righteous_fury.name: Improved Righteous Fury
improved_righteous_fury.tooltipTemplate: While Righteous Fury is active, damage taken is reduced by [V1]%.

toughness.name: Toughness
toughness.tooltipTemplate: Increases your armor value from items by [V1]% and reduces the duration of all movement slowing effects by [V2]%.

divine_guardian.name: Divine Guardian
divine_guardian.tooltipTemplate: When Divine Sacrifice is activated, your party and raid members within 30 yards take [V1]% reduced damage for 6 sec.  In addition, increases the duration of your Sacred Shield by [V2]% and the amount absorbed by [V3]%.

improved_hammer_of_justice.name: Improved Hammer of Justice
improved_hammer_of_justice.tooltipTemplate: Decreases the cooldown of your Hammer of Justice spell by [V1] sec.

improved_devotion_aura.name: Improved Devotion Aura
improved_devotion_aura.tooltipTemplate: Increases the armor bonus of your Devotion Aura by [V1]% and increases the amount healed on any target affected by any of your Auras by [V2]%.

blessing_of_sanctuary.name: Blessing of Sanctuary
blessing_of_sanctuary.tooltipTemplate: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, reducing damage taken from all sources by 3% for 30 min and increasing strength and stamina by 10%.  In addition, when the target blocks, parries, or dodges a melee attack the target will gain 2% of maximum displayed mana.  Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

reckoning.name: Reckoning
reckoning.tooltipTemplate: Gives you a 10% chance after blocking or being hit by any damaging attack that the next 4 weapon swings within 8 sec will generate an additional attack.

sacred_duty.name: Sacred Duty
sacred_duty.tooltipTemplate:
Increases your total Stamina by [V1]%.

Reduces the chance you'll be critically hit by monsters' melee attacks by [V2]%.

Reduces the cooldown of your Divine Shield and Divine Protection by [V3] sec.

one_handed_weapon_specialization.name: One-Handed Weapon Specialization
one_handed_weapon_specialization.tooltipTemplate: Increases all damage you deal when a one-handed melee weapon is equipped by [V1]%.

spiritual_attunement.name: Spiritual Attunement
spiritual_attunement.tooltipTemplate: A passive ability that gives the Paladin mana when healed by other friendly targets' spells.  The amount of mana gained is equal to [V1]% of the amount healed.

holy_shield.name: Holy Shield
holy_shield.tooltipTemplate: Increases chance to block by 30% for 10 sec and deals 79 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active.  Each block expends a charge.  8 charges.

ardent_defender.name: Ardent Defender
ardent_defender.tooltipTemplate: Damage that takes you below 35% health is reduced by [V1]%.  In addition, attacks which would otherwise kill you cause you to be healed by up to [V2]% of your maximum health (amount healed based on defense).  This healing effect cannot occur more often than once every 90 sec.

redoubt.name: Redoubt
redoubt.tooltipTemplate: Increases your block value by [V1]% and damaging melee and ranged attacks against you have a 10% chance to increase your chance to block by [V2]%.  Lasts 10 sec or 5 blocks.

combat_expertise.name: Combat Expertise
combat_expertise.tooltipTemplate: Increases your Expertise by [V1], total Stamina and chance to critically hit by [V2]%.

touched_by_the_light.name: Touched by the Light
touched_by_the_light.tooltipTemplate: Increases your spell power by an amount equal to [V1]% of your Strength and increases the amount healed by your critical heals by [V2]%.

avengers_shield.name: Avenger's Shield
avengers_shield.tooltipTemplate: Hurls a holy shield at the enemy, dealing 440 to 536 Holy damage, Dazing them and then jumping to additional nearby enemies.  Affects 3 total targets.  Lasts 10 sec.

guarded_by_the_light.name: Guarded by the Light
guarded_by_the_light.tooltipTemplate: Spell damage taken is reduced by [V1]% and gives a [V2]% chance to refresh the duration of your Divine Plea when you hit an enemy.  In addition, your Divine Plea spell is [V3]% less likely to be dispelled.

shield_of_the_templar.name: Shield of the Templar
shield_of_the_templar.tooltipTemplate: Reduces all damage taken by [V1]% and grants your Avenger's Shield a [V2]% chance to silence your targets for 3 sec.

judgements_of_the_just.name: Judgements of the Just
judgements_of_the_just.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Hammer of Justice by [V1] sec, increases the duration of your Seal of Justice effect by [V2] sec and your Judgement spells also reduce the melee attack speed of the target by [V3]%.

hammer_of_the_righteous.name: Hammer of the Righteous
hammer_of_the_righteous.tooltipTemplate:
Hammer the current target and up to 2 additional nearby targets, causing 4 times your main hand damage per second as Holy damage.

Shares cooldown with Crusader Strike.

spiritual_focus.name: Spiritual Focus
spiritual_focus.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Flash of Light and Holy Light by [V1]%.

seals_of_the_pure.name: Seals of the Pure
seals_of_the_pure.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Seal of Righteousness, Seal of Vengeance and Seal of Corruption and their Judgement effects by [V1]%.

healing_light.name: Healing Light
healing_light.tooltipTemplate: Increases the amount healed by your Holy Light, Flash of Light and the effectiveness of Holy Shock spells by [V1]%.

unyielding_faith.name: Unyielding Faith
unyielding_faith.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the duration of all Fear and Disorient effects by [V1]%.

aura_mastery.name: Aura Mastery
aura_mastery.tooltipTemplate: Causes your Concentration Aura to make all affected targets immune to Silence and Interrupt effects and improve the effect of all other auras by 100%.  Lasts 6 sec.

illumination.name: Illumination
illumination.tooltipTemplate: After getting a critical effect from your Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock heal spell you have a [V1]% chance to gain mana equal to 30% of the base cost of the spell.

improved_lay_on_hands.name: Improved Lay on Hands
improved_lay_on_hands.tooltipTemplate: Grants the target of your Lay on Hands spell [V1]% reduced physical damage taken for 15 sec.  In addition, the cooldown for your Lay on Hands spell is reduced by [V2] min.

improved_concentration_aura.name: Improved Concentration Aura
improved_concentration_aura.tooltipTemplate: Increases the effect of your Concentration Aura by an additional [V1]% and while any Aura is active reduces the duration of any Silence or Interrupt effect used against an affected group member by [V2]%.  The duration reduction does not stack with any other effects.

improved_blessing_of_wisdom.name: Improved Blessing of Wisdom
improved_blessing_of_wisdom.tooltipTemplate: Increases the effect of your Blessing of Wisdom spell by [V1]%.

blessed_hands.name: Blessed Hands
blessed_hands.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of Hand of Freedom, Hand of Sacrifice and Hand of Salvation by [V1]%, increases the effectiveness of Hand of Salvation by [V2]% and the effectiveness of Hand of Sacrifice by an additional [V3]%.

pure_of_heart.name: Pure of Heart
pure_of_heart.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the duration of Curse, Disease and Poison effects by [V1]%.

divine_favor.name: Divine Favor
divine_favor.tooltipTemplate: When activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a 100% critical effect chance.

sanctified_light.name: Sanctified Light
sanctified_light.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy Light and Holy Shock spells by [V1]%.

purifying_power.name: Purifying Power
purifying_power.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of your Cleanse, Purify and Consecration spells by [V1]% and reduces the cooldown of your Exorcism and Holy Wrath spells by [V2]%.

holy_power.name: Holy Power
holy_power.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by [V1]%.

lights_grace.name: Light's Grace
lights_grace.tooltipTemplate: Gives your Holy Light spell a [V1]% chance to reduce the cast time of your next Holy Light spell by 0.5 sec.  This effect lasts 15 sec.

holy_shock.name: Holy Shock
holy_shock.tooltipTemplate: Blasts the target with Holy energy, causing 314 to 340 Holy damage to an enemy, or 433 to 467 healing to an ally.

blessed_life.name: Blessed Life
blessed_life.tooltipTemplate: All attacks against you have a [V1]% chance to cause half damage.

sacred_cleansing.name: Sacred Cleansing
sacred_cleansing.tooltipTemplate: Your Cleanse spell has a [V1]% chance to increase the target's resistance to Disease, Magic and Poison by 30% for 10 sec.

holy_guidance.name: Holy Guidance
holy_guidance.tooltipTemplate: Increases your spell power by [V1]% of your total Intellect.

divine_illumination.name: Divine Illumination
divine_illumination.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of all spells by 50% for 15 sec.

judgements_of_the_pure.name: Judgements of the Pure
judgements_of_the_pure.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Seal and Judgement spells by [V1]%, and your Judgement spells increase your casting and melee haste by [V2]% for 1 min.

infusion_of_light.name: Infusion of Light
infusion_of_light.tooltipTemplate: Your Holy Shock critical hits reduce the cast time of your next Flash of Light by [V1] sec or increase the critical chance of your next Holy Light by [V2]%.  In addition, causes your Flash of Light to heal targets with Sacred Shield for an additional [V3]% over 12 sec.

enlightened_judgements.name: Enlightened Judgements
enlightened_judgements.tooltipTemplate: Increases the range of your Judgement of Light and Judgement of Wisdom spells by [V1] yards and increases your chance to hit by [V2]%.

beacon_of_light.name: Beacon of Light
beacon_of_light.tooltipTemplate: The target becomes a Beacon of Light to all members of your party or raid within a 60 yard radius.  Any direct heals you cast on party or raid members will also heal the Beacon for 100% of the amount healed.  Only one target can be the Beacon of Light at a time. Lasts 1 min.

benediction.name: Benediction
benediction.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of all instant cast spells by [V1]%.

improved_judgements.name: Improved Judgements
improved_judgements.tooltipTemplate: Decreases the cooldown of your Judgement spells by [V1] sec.

heart_of_the_crusader.name: Heart of the Crusader
heart_of_the_crusader.tooltipTemplate: In addition to the normal effect, your Judgement spells will also increase the critical strike chance of all attacks made against that target by an additional [V1]%.

improved_blessing_of_might.name: Improved Blessing of Might
improved_blessing_of_might.tooltipTemplate: Increases the attack power bonus of your Blessing of Might by [V1]%.

vindication.name: Vindication
vindication.tooltipTemplate: Gives the Paladin's damaging attacks a chance to reduce the target's attack power by [V1] for 12 sec.

conviction.name: Conviction
conviction.tooltipTemplate: Increases your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by [V1]%.

seal_of_command.name: Seal of Command
seal_of_command.tooltipTemplate:
All melee attacks deal 0 to 0 additional Holy damage.  When used with attacks or abilities that strike a single target, this additional Holy damage will strike up to 2 additional targets.  Lasts 30 min.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 0 to 0 Holy damage.

pursuit_of_justice.name: Pursuit of Justice
pursuit_of_justice.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the duration of all Disarm effects by [V1]% and increases movement and mounted movement speed by [V2]%.  This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.

eye_for_an_eye.name: Eye for an Eye
eye_for_an_eye.tooltipTemplate: All criticals against you cause [V1]% of the damage taken to the attacker as well.  The damage caused by Eye for an Eye will not exceed 50% of the Paladin's total health.

sanctity_of_battle.name: Sanctity of Battle
sanctity_of_battle.tooltipTemplate: Increases your chance to critically hit with all spells and attacks by [V1]% and increases the damage caused by Exorcism and Crusader Strike by [V2]%.

crusade.name: Crusade
crusade.tooltipTemplate: Increases all damage caused by [V1]% and all damage caused against Humanoids, Demons, Undead and Elementals by an additional [V2]%.

two_handed_weapon_specialization.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
two_handed_weapon_specialization.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by [V1]%.

sanctified_retribution.name: Sanctified Retribution
sanctified_retribution.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage caused by Retribution Aura by 50% and all damage caused by friendly targets affected by any of your Auras is increased by 3%.

vengeance.name: Vengeance
vengeance.tooltipTemplate: Gives you a [V1]% bonus to Physical and Holy damage you deal for 30 sec after dealing a critical strike from a weapon swing, spell, or ability.  This effect stacks up to 3 times.

divine_purpose.name: Divine Purpose
divine_purpose.tooltipTemplate: Reduces your chance to be hit by spells and ranged attacks by [V1]% and gives your Hand of Freedom spell a [V2]% chance to remove any Stun effects on the target.

the_art_of_war.name: The Art of War
the_art_of_war.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage of your Judgement, Crusader Strike and Divine Storm abilities by 10% and when your melee attacks critically hit your next Flash of Light  or Exorcism spell becomes instant cast.

repentance.name: Repentance
repentance.tooltipTemplate: Puts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to 1 min, and removing the effect of Righteous Vengeance.  Any damage caused will awaken the target.  Usable against Demons, Dragonkin, Giants, Humanoids and Undead.

judgements_of_the_wise.name: Judgements of the Wise
judgements_of_the_wise.tooltipTemplate: Your damaging Judgement spells have a [V1]% chance to grant the Replenishment effect to up to 10 party or raid members mana regeneration equal to 1% of their maximum mana per 5 sec for 15 sec, and to immediately grant you 25% of your base mana.

fanaticism.name: Fanaticism
fanaticism.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of all Judgements capable of a critical hit by [V1]% and reduces threat caused by all actions by [V2]% except when under the effects of Righteous Fury.

sanctified_wrath.name: Sanctified Wrath
sanctified_wrath.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of Hammer of Wrath by [V1]%, reduces the cooldown of Avenging Wrath by [V2] secs and while affected by Avenging Wrath [V3]% of all damage caused bypasses damage reduction effects.

swift_retribution.name: Swift Retribution
swift_retribution.tooltipTemplate: Your auras also increase casting, ranged and melee attack speeds by [V1]%.

promise_of_the_crusader.name: Promise of the Crusader
promise_of_the_crusader.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance and the chance to hit with Exorcism by 10%.

sheath_of_light.name: Sheath of Light
sheath_of_light.tooltipTemplate: Increases your spell power by an amount equal to [V1]% of your attack power and your critical healing spells heal the target for [V2]% of the healed amount over 12 seconds.

righteous_vengeance.name: Righteous Vengeance
righteous_vengeance.tooltipTemplate: When any of your melee abilities deal a critical strike, your target will take [V1]% additional damage over 8 sec.

divine_storm.name: Divine Storm
divine_storm.tooltipTemplate: An instant weapon attack that causes 110% of weapon damage to up to 4 enemies within 8 yards.  The Divine Storm heals up to 3 party or raid members totaling 25% of the damage caused.

enchants.name: Aegis of the Martyr
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you Aegis of the Martyr.
Aegis of the Martyr: Sacrifice 30% of your max health to place a powerful aegis on your target, absorbing up to ${2326*0.99)+(0*1.5} damage for 10 sec and heals them for 2196. If you have below 30% health you will be left with 1 health.

enchants.name: Blinding Light
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Blinding Light. 
Blinding Light: Emits dazzling light in all directions, blinding enemies within 10 yards, causing them to wander disoriented for 6 sec.

enchants.name: Divine Steed
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Divine Steed. 
Divine Steed: Leap atop your Charger for 3 sec, increasing movement speed by 70%. Usable while indoors and in combat.

enchants.name: Light's Hammer
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Light's Hammer. 
Light's Hammer: Hurl a Light-infused hammer into the ground, where it will blast a 10 yard area with Arcing Light for 10 sec.

Deals Holy damage to enemies and reduces their movement speed by 50% for 3 sec. Also heals up to 5 allies every 2.5 sec.

enchants.name: A New Dawn
enchants.tooltip:
Healing an ally with Light of Dawn or the direct part of Word of Glory makes your next Flash of Light, Holy Light or Holy Shock on them heal for 20% more.

In addition, casting Holy Light now generates one Holy Power.

enchants.name: Armor of Wrath
enchants.tooltip: The cooldown of Holy Wrath is reduced by 10 seconds. Casting Hammer of Wrath or Holy Wrath reduces all damage taken by 5% for 6 sec.

enchants.name: Baleful Hammer
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Holy Shield
Increases your armor by 15% while Holy Shield is active. Using Hammer of the Righteous increases the charges of your active Holy Shield by 4.

enchants.name: Blessed Hammer
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Hammer of the Righteous
Your Hammer of the Righteous deals 10% increased damage and increases your Holy damage done on enemies hit by 3% for 15 sec, stacking up to 3 times.

enchants.name: Branding Zeal
enchants.tooltip:
Increases the damage of your Seal and Judgement of Righteousness by 15%. 

Using a Judgement empowers Exorcism, Holy Shock, Hammer of Wrath and Holy Wrath, allowing them to trigger your Seal of Righteousness for 10 sec.

enchants.name: Consecrated Weapon
enchants.tooltip: Your Consecration empowers your weapon for 10 sec, increasing your melee critical chance by 6% and giving attacks a chance to restore 5% base mana.

enchants.name: Consecrated Zeal
enchants.tooltip:
Standing in your Consecration grants you Consecrated Zeal.
Consecrated Zeal: Increases Holy damage done by 8% and reduces physical damage taken by 4%, lasting for 8 sec.

enchants.name: Crusader of the Light
enchants.tooltip:
After 12 auto attacks or melee abilities your next auto attack hits twice and reduces the cooldown of Avenging Wrath by 10 seconds.

While Avenging Wrath is active you gain 2 stacks.

enchants.name: Crusader's Judgement
enchants.tooltip: Your Crusader Strike deals 30% additional damage on targets affected by a Judgement effect.

enchants.name: Divine Order
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Divine Illumination
Divine Illumination also increases your critical strike chance with all spells by 20% for its duration. In addition, the mana gained from your Illumination talent is increased by an additional 10%.

enchants.name: Divine Reprieve
enchants.tooltip: Your Divine Plea only reduces your healing done with Holy Light, Flash of Light and Holy Shock by 20% and additionally increases your chance to critically heal with those spells by 10%.

enchants.name: Divine Resurgence
enchants.tooltip: Divine Storm and Judgement have 15% increased critical strike chance and have a 20% chance not to trigger any cooldown.

enchants.name: Divine Sacrifice
Execution Verdict
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Holy Templar
Using Hammer of Wrath or Exorcism grants you a charge of Holy Power.

Templar's Verdict now grants a Holy Power and gains 25% increased critical strike chance and damage when used on targets below 35% health.

enchants.name: Fierce Vengeance
Light of Dawn
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Holy Templar
Teaches you: Light of Dawn. 
Light of Dawn: Consumes 3 Holy Power, releasing a cone of Holy energy, healing up to 10 injured allies within a 30 yd frontal cone for 193.

enchants.name: Long Arm of the Law
enchants.tooltip:
Dealing damage with Hand of Reckoning increases your movement speed by 50% for 3 sec.

While active, dealing damage with a Judgement effect extends the duration by 2 sec.

enchants.name: Pious Strikes
enchants.tooltip: Your Crusader Strike and Avenger's Shield deal 10% of its damage to nearby enemies as Holy damage and restores 5% base mana. This effect generates high threat.

enchants.name: Righteous Light
enchants.tooltip:
Increases the damage and threat of Shield of Righteousness by 20%.
 
Using Shield of Righteousness causes your next Hand of Reckoning to heal you for 5% of your missing health, stacking up to 5 times.

enchants.name: Righteous Verdict
enchants.tooltip: Using a Judgement reduces the mana cost of your next Holy Light by 30% and increases its critical strike chance by 25%.

enchants.name: Sacred Light
enchants.tooltip: Your Sacred Shield now applies an empowered absorb shield when applied but has a 30 second cooldown. In addition, the target of your Sacred Shield takes 10% increased healing from you.

enchants.name: Sacred Unity
Shield of Wrath
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Avenger's Shield
The cooldown of your Avenger's Shield is reduced by 20% but it no longer slows any targets hit.

Casting Avenger's Shield grants you Holy Shield.

enchants.name: Spark of Hope
enchants.tooltip: Your Holy Light, Flash of Light and Holy Shock has an additional 12% critical strike chance when healing an ally below 50% health.

enchants.name: Swift Avenger
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Avenger's Shield
Your Avenger's Shield hits up to 3 additional targets. For each target hit, you gain 10% increased movement speed. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts 4 sec.

enchants.name: Swift Execution
enchants.tooltip: Activating Avenging Wrath resets the cooldown of Execution Sentence. In addition, your Judgement of Righteousness deals 25% increased damage (5% against players) tripled while Avenging Wrath is active.

enchants.name: Swift Favor
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Divine Favor
Your Divine Favor also increases the effectiveness of your next Flash of Light, Holy Light or Holy Shock by 30%.

Healing with Flash of Light, Holy Light and Holy Shock reduces the cooldown of Divine Favor by 2 sec.

enchants.name: Sword of Vengeance
enchants.tooltip: When using a Judgement on a target with 5 stacks of your Seal of Vengeance or Seal of Corruption, you deal 0 additional Holy damage to the target and other enemies within 5 yards.

enchants.name: Synergistic Light
enchants.tooltip:
Casting Flash of Light increases the critical strike chance of your next Holy Light by 15% and reduces its mana cost by 15%. This can stack twice.

Casting Holy Light reduces the cooldown of Holy Shock by 1 sec.

enchants.name: Wrathful Exorcism
enchants.tooltip: Using Exorcism allows your next Hammer of Wrath to be used regardless of the targets health.

enchants.name: Blessing of the Divines
enchants.tooltip:
Your Paladin heals have a 33% chance to trigger a random blessing. This can only occur once every 5 seconds.

Blessing of the Divines: Increases healing taken by 5% and reduces damage taken by 5%.
Blessing of Radiance: Heals 3 party or raid members within 30 yards of you for ${291*0.99)+(0*0.12)}.
Blessing of Mending: Heals 3 party or raid members within 30 yards of you every 3 seconds for ${143*0.99)+(0*0.036)}. Lasts 15 sec.

enchants.name: Crimson Defense
enchants.tooltip:
Blocking attacks grants you Crimson Defender.

Increases your chance to Block by 10%.

Crimson Defender: Consume 3 stacks to empower your next ability. Stacks up to 6 times and lasts for 15 sec.

- Shield of Righteousness: Deals an additional ${100*0.99)+(0*0.2)+(0*0.15)} Holy damage to 5 nearby enemies.

- Avenger's Shield: Increases your block value by 15% and threat by 15% for 20 sec.

enchants.name: Execution Sentence
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Execution Sentence. 
Execution Sentence: A hammer slowly falls from the sky, causing Holy damage over 10 sec. This culminates in a final burst of damage, dealing damage to enemies within 5 yards. Dispelling the effect triggers the final burst.

Using Judgement on a target affected by your Execution Sentence only triggers half its cooldown.

Execution Sentence stores 20% of your damage dealt to the target while the debuff is active and releases it when the debuff ends.

enchants.name: Gift of Light
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Light's Grace
Light's Grace gains an additional -0.25 cast speed reduction.

Your Light's Grace is automatically renewed every 15 seconds. When renewed, you gain a stack of Gift of Light, empowering your Divine Favor to not trigger a cooldown, stacking up to 3 times. You cannot use Divine Favor again until you gain the next Gift of Light.

enchants.name: Glimmer of Light
enchants.tooltip:
Flash of Light leaves a Glimmer of Light on any friendly target healed, lasting for 15 sec.

Glimmer of Light: Increases the critical strike chance of the Paladins Holy Light and Flash of Light by 15%.

Healing any ally with Holy Shock also heals allies with your Glimmer of Light for 70% of the healing done.

enchants.name: Guardian of Ancient Kings
Hammerstorm
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Hammerstorm. 
Hammerstorm: Holy hammers surround you for 6 sec, increasing your armor by 30% and dealing 47.8 Holy damage every second to nearby enemies and reduces their attack speed by 20% for 15 sec.

enchants.name: Holy Mastery
enchants.tooltip: Increases the critical strike chance of your spells by 4% and reduces their mana cost by 4%.

enchants.name: Holy Templar
Light of the Guardian
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Light of the Guardian. 
Light of the Guardian: Absorbs 434.47 damage and deals 493.72 high-threat Holy damage to enemies within 8 yards of the Paladin. 

Reduces damage taken from creatures by 20% and increases healing received by 30% for 8 sec.

enchants.name: One With The Light
enchants.tooltip:
Increases your Holy damage by 10% and Healing taken by 10% but reduces your Physical damage dealt by 10%.

Your Crusader Strike, Divine Storm and Hammer of the Righteous deal extra Holy damage, scaling with your spell power.

enchants.name: Protection Mastery
enchants.tooltip: Reduces all damage taken in Righteous Fury by 3% and increases all threat generated by 12%.

enchants.name: Retribution Mastery
enchants.tooltip: Increases your chance to critically strike with attacks by 4% and increases all Holy damage done by 4%.

enchants.name: Twist of Faith
enchants.tooltip:
Using Seal of Righteousness, Seal of Command, Seal of Vengeance or Seal of Corruption while a different one of these seals is already active grants you the previously active seal for 12 sec. Only one echo can be active at a time.

These seals have their global cooldown reduced to 1 sec, no longer cost any mana but have a 8 second cooldown.

enchants.name: Anticipation
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases your chance to dodge by 5%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Anticipation Talent.

enchants.name: Aura Mastery
Benediction
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the mana cost of all instant cast spells by 10%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Benediction Talent.

enchants.name: Blessed Hands
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the mana cost of Hand of Freedom, Hand of Sacrifice and Hand of Salvation by 30%, increases the effectiveness of Hand of Salvation by 100% and the effectiveness of Hand of Sacrifice by an additional 10%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Blessed Hands Talent.

enchants.name: Conviction
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 6%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Conviction Talent.

enchants.name: Crusade
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases all damage caused by 3% and all damage caused against Humanoids, Demons, Undead and Elementals by an additional 3%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Crusade Talent.

enchants.name: Deflection
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases your Parry chance by 5%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Deflection Talent.

enchants.name: Divine Guardian
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
When Divine Sacrifice is activated, your party and raid members within 30 yards take 20% reduced damage for 6 sec.  In addition, increases the duration of your Sacred Shield by 100% and the amount absorbed by 20%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Divine Guardian Talent.

enchants.name: Divine Intellect
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases your total Intellect by 10%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Divine Intellect Talent.

enchants.name: Divine Strength
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases your total Strength by 15%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Divine Strength Talent.

enchants.name: Divinity
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases all healing done by you and all healing effects on you by 5%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Divinity Talent.

enchants.name: Eye for an Eye
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
All criticals against you cause 10% of the damage taken to the attacker as well.  The damage caused by Eye for an Eye will not exceed 50% of the Paladin's total health.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Eye for an Eye Talent.

enchants.name: Glyph of Avenger's Shield
enchants.tooltip:
Your Avenger's Shield deals 100% more damage but no longer jumps to any additional targets.

@ext:The damage is increased by 50% in PvP combat.:ext@

enchants.name: Glyph of Avenging Wrath
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the cooldown of your Hammer of Wrath spell by 50% while Avenging Wrath is active.

enchants.name: Glyph of Beacon of Light
enchants.tooltip: Increases the duration of Beacon of Light to 10 min but has a 2 second cast time.

enchants.name: Glyph of Cleansing
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the mana cost of your Cleanse and Purify spells by 20%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Consecration
enchants.tooltip: Increases the duration and cooldown of Consecration by 2 sec and the damage by 20%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Crusader Strike
enchants.tooltip: Increases your critical strike chance of Crusader Strike by 3% and reduces the mana cost by 50%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Divine Plea
enchants.tooltip: While Divine Plea is active, you take 3% reduced damage from all sources.

enchants.name: Glyph of Divine Storm
enchants.tooltip: Your Divine Storm now heals for an additional 15% of the damage it causes.

enchants.name: Glyph of Divinity
enchants.tooltip: Your Lay on Hands grants twice as much mana as normal and also grants you as much mana as it grants your target.

enchants.name: Glyph of Exorcism
enchants.tooltip: Increases damage done by Exorcism by 20%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Flash of Light
enchants.tooltip: Your Flash of Light has an additional 5% critical strike chance.

enchants.name: Glyph of Hammer of Justice
enchants.tooltip: Increases your Hammer of Justice range by 5 yards.

enchants.name: Glyph of Hammer of Wrath
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the mana cost of Hammer of Wrath by -100% and increases the critical strike damage of Hammer of Wrath by 20%, doubled for targets under 20% health.

enchants.name: Glyph of Hammer of the Righteous
enchants.tooltip: Your Hammer of the Righteous hits 1 additional target.

enchants.name: Glyph of Holy Light
enchants.tooltip: Your Holy Light grants 10% of its heal amount to up to 5 friendly targets within 8 yards of the initial target.

enchants.name: Glyph of Holy Shock
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the cooldown of Holy Shock by -1 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Holy Wrath
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the cooldown of your Holy Wrath spell by -15 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Judgement
enchants.tooltip: Your Judgements deal 25% more damage but have a 1 second increased cooldown and are guaranteed to trigger Vindication if known.

enchants.name: Glyph of Salvation
enchants.tooltip: When you cast Hand of Salvation on yourself, it also reduces damage taken by 20%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Seal of Command
enchants.tooltip: You gain 8% of your base mana each time you use a Judgement with Seal of Command active.

enchants.name: Glyph of Seal of Light
enchants.tooltip: While Seal of Light is active, the effect of your healing spells is increased by 5%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Seal of Righteousness
enchants.tooltip: Increases the damage done by Seal of Righteousness by 10%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Seal of Wisdom
enchants.tooltip: While Seal of Wisdom is active, the cost of your healing spells is reduced by 5%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Shield of Righteousness
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the mana cost by 80% and increases critical strike chance by 20% of Shield of Righteousness.

enchants.name: Glyph of Spiritual Attunement
enchants.tooltip: Increases the amount of mana gained from your Spiritual Attunement spell by an additional 2%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Turn Evil
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the casting time of your Turn Evil spell by 100%, but increases the cooldown by 8 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Vengeance
enchants.tooltip: Seal of Vengeance and Seal of Corruption increases your expertise by 10.

enchants.name: Guardian's Favor
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the cooldown of your Hand of Protection by 2 min and increases the duration of your Hand of Freedom by 4 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Guardian's Favor Talent.

enchants.name: Healing Light
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the amount healed by your Holy Light, Flash of Light and the effectiveness of Holy Shock spells by 12%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Healing Light Talent.

enchants.name: Heart of the Crusader
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
In addition to the normal effect, your Judgement spells will also increase the critical strike chance of all attacks made against that target by an additional 3%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Heart of the Crusader Talent.

enchants.name: Illumination
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
After getting a critical effect from your Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock heal spell you have a 100% chance to gain mana equal to 30% of the base cost of the spell.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Illumination Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Blessing of Might
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the attack power bonus of your Blessing of Might by 25%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Blessing of Might Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Blessing of Wisdom
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the effect of your Blessing of Wisdom spell by 20%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Blessing of Wisdom Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Concentration Aura
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the effect of your Concentration Aura by an additional 15% and while any Aura is active reduces the duration of any Silence or Interrupt effect used against an affected group member by 30%.  The duration reduction does not stack with any other effects.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Concentration Aura Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Devotion Aura
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the armor bonus of your Devotion Aura by 50% and increases the amount healed on any target affected by any of your Auras by 6%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Devotion Aura Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Hammer of Justice
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Decreases the cooldown of your Hammer of Justice spell by 20 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Hammer of Justice Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Judgements
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Decreases the cooldown of your Judgement spells by 2 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Judgements Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Lay on Hands
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Grants the target of your Lay on Hands spell 20% reduced physical damage taken for 15 sec.  In addition, the cooldown for your Lay on Hands spell is reduced by -4 min.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Lay on Hands Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Righteous Fury
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
While Righteous Fury is active, damage taken is reduced by 9%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Righteous Fury Talent.

enchants.name: Pursuit of Justice
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the duration of all Disarm effects by 50% and increases movement and mounted movement speed by 15%.  This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Pursuit of Justice Talent.

enchants.name: Sanctity of Battle
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases your chance to critically hit with all spells and attacks by 3% and increases the damage caused by Exorcism and Crusader Strike by 15%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Sanctity of Battle Talent.

enchants.name: Seal of Command
Seals of the Pure
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the damage done by your Seal of Righteousness, Seal of Vengeance and Seal of Corruption and their Judgement effects by 15%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Seals of the Pure Talent.

enchants.name: Spiritual Focus
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Flash of Light and Holy Light by 70%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Spiritual Focus Talent.

enchants.name: Stoicism
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the duration of all Stun effects by an additional 30% and reduces the chance your helpful spells and damage over time effects will be dispelled by an additional 30%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Stoicism Talent.

enchants.name: Toughness
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases your armor value from items by 10% and reduces the duration of all movement slowing effects by 30%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Toughness Talent.

enchants.name: Unyielding Faith
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the duration of all Fear and Disorient effects by 30%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Unyielding Faith Talent.

enchants.name: Vindication
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Gives the Paladin's damaging attacks a chance to reduce the target's attack power by 166.2 for 12 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Vindication Talent.

abilities.name: Aura Mastery
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Causes your Concentration Aura to make all affected targets immune to Silence and Interrupt effects and improve the effect of all other auras by 100%.  Lasts 6 sec.

abilities.name: Beacon of Light
abilities.tooltipTemplate: The target becomes a Beacon of Light to all members of your party or raid within a 60 yard radius.  Any direct heals you cast on party or raid members will also heal the Beacon for 100% of the amount healed.  Only one target can be the Beacon of Light at a time. Lasts 1 min.

abilities.name: Blessing of Wisdom
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Bless all members of the raid or group with a Sanctified Blessing of Wisdom, restoring 33 mana every 5 seconds for 30 min.  Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Cleanse
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Cleanses a friendly target, removing 1 poison effect, 1 disease effect, and 1 magic effect.

abilities.name: Concentration Aura
abilities.tooltipTemplate: All party or raid members within 40 yards lose 35% less casting or channeling time when damaged.  Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Consecration
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Consecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 448 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area.

abilities.name: Divine Illumination
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of all spells by 50% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Divine Plea
abilities.tooltipTemplate: You gain 25% of your total mana over 15 sec, but the amount healed by your Flash of Light, Holy Light, and Holy Shock spells is reduced by 50%.

abilities.name: Exorcism
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Causes 564 to 628 Holy damage to an enemy target.  If the target is Undead or Demon, it will always critically hit.

abilities.name: Flash of Light
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Heals a friendly target for 324.

abilities.name: Holy Light
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Heals a friendly target for 1464.

abilities.name: Holy Shock
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Blasts the target with Holy energy, causing 314 to 340 Holy damage to an enemy, or 433 to 467 healing to an ally.

abilities.name: Holy Wrath
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Sends bolts of holy power in all directions, causing 551 to 649 Holy damage and stunning all Undead and Demon targets within 10 yds for 3 sec.

abilities.name: Lay on Hands
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Heals a friendly target for an amount equal to the Paladin's maximum health and restores 550 of their mana.  If used on self, the Paladin cannot be targeted by Divine Shield, Divine Protection, Hand of Protection, or self-targeted Lay on Hands again for 2 min.  Also cannot be used on self within 30 sec of using Avenging Wrath.

abilities.name: Purify
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Purifies the friendly target, removing 1 disease effect and 1 poison effect.

abilities.name: Redemption
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Brings a dead player back to life with 600 health and 800 mana.  Cannot be cast when in combat.

abilities.name: Sacred Shield
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Each time the target takes damage they gain a Sacred Shield, absorbing 100 damage and increasing the paladin's chance to critically hit with Flash of Light by 50% for up to 6 sec.  They cannot gain this effect more than once every 6 sec.  Lasts 30 sec.  This spell cannot be on more than one target at any one time.

abilities.name: Seal of Light
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Fills the Paladin with divine light for 30 min, giving each melee attack a chance to heal the Paladin for 0.  Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will deal 1 Holy damage to an enemy.

abilities.name: Seal of Righteousness
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Fills the Paladin with holy spirit for 30 min, granting each melee attack ${0*(0.022*0+0.044*0)} additional Holy damage.  Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will cause 1 Holy damage to an enemy.

abilities.name: Seal of Wisdom
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Fills the Paladin with divine wisdom for 30 min, giving each melee attack a chance to restore 4% of the paladin's maximum mana.  Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will deal 1 Holy damage to an enemy.

abilities.name: Turn Evil
abilities.tooltipTemplate: The targeted undead or demon enemy will be compelled to flee for up to 20 sec.  Damage caused may interrupt the effect.  Only one target can be turned at a time.

abilities.name: Avenger's Shield
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Hurls a holy shield at the enemy, dealing 440 to 536 Holy damage, Dazing them and then jumping to additional nearby enemies.  Affects 3 total targets.  Lasts 10 sec.

abilities.name: Blessing of Kings
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Bless all members of the raid or group with a Greater Blessing of Kings, increasing total stats by 10% for 30 min.  Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Blessing of Sanctuary
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, reducing damage taken from all sources by 3% for 30 min and increasing strength and stamina by 10%.  In addition, when the target blocks, parries, or dodges a melee attack the target will gain 2% of maximum displayed mana.  Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Crimson Champion
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Increase your Block chance by 10% and blocking deals 90 Holy damage to the attacker.

@ext:This uses Holy Shield modifiers. This effect can only occur once every second.:ext@

abilities.name: Crusader's Hammer
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Slams the ground with a holy hammer, stunning all enemies around you for 4 sec.

@ext:This uses Hammer of Justice modifiers.:ext@

abilities.name: Devotion Aura
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Gives 735 additional armor to party and raid members within 40 yards.  Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Divine Intervention
abilities.tooltipTemplate: The paladin sacrifices himself to remove the targeted party member from harm's way.  Enemies will stop attacking the protected party member, who will be immune to all harmful attacks but will not be able to take any action for 3 min.

abilities.name: Divine Protection
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Reduces all damage taken by 50% for 12 sec.  Once protected, the target cannot be targeted by Divine Shield, Divine Protection, or Hand of Protection again for 2 min.  Cannot be used within 30 sec of using Avenging Wrath.

abilities.name: Divine Sacrifice
abilities.tooltipTemplate: 30% of all damage taken by party members within 30 yards is redirected to the Paladin (up to a maximum of 40% of the Paladin's health times the number of party members).  Damage which reduces the Paladin below 20% health will break the effect.  Lasts 10 sec.

abilities.name: Divine Shield
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Protects the paladin from all damage and spells for 12 sec, but reduces all damage you deal by 50%.  Once protected, the target cannot be targeted by Divine Shield, Divine Protection, or Hand of Protection again for 2 min.  Cannot be used within 30 sec. of using Avenging Wrath.

abilities.name: Fire Resistance Aura
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Gives 60 additional Fire resistance to all party and raid members within 40 yards.  Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Frost Resistance Aura
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Gives 60 additional Frost resistance to all party and raid members within 40 yards.  Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Hammer of Justice
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Stuns the target for 6 sec and interrupts non-player spellcasting for 3 sec.

abilities.name: Hammer of the Righteous
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Hammer the current target and up to 2 additional nearby targets, causing 4 times your main hand damage per second as Holy damage.

Shares cooldown with Crusader Strike.

abilities.name: Hand of Freedom
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Places a Hand on the friendly target, granting immunity to movement impairing effects for 6 sec.  Players may only have one Hand on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Hand of Protection
abilities.tooltipTemplate: A targeted party or raid member is protected from all physical attacks for 10 sec, but during that time they cannot attack or use physical abilities.  Players may only have one Hand on them per Paladin at any one time.  Once protected, the target cannot be targeted by Divine Shield, Divine Protection, or Hand of Protection again for 2 min.  Cannot be targeted on players who have used Avenging Wrath within the last 30 sec.

abilities.name: Hand of Reckoning
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Taunts the target to attack you.  If the target is tauntable and not currently targeting you, causes 1 Holy damage.

This spell can not miss.

abilities.name: Hand of Reckoning (Fist of Reckoning)
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Causes 1 Holy damage. This ability does not trigger a global cooldown.

abilities.name: Hand of Sacrifice
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Places a Hand on the party or raid member, transfering 30% damage taken to the caster.  Lasts 12 sec or until the caster has transfered 100% of their maximum health.  Players may only have one Hand on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Hand of Salvation
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Places a Hand on the party or raid member, reducing their total threat by 2% every 1 sec. for 10 sec.  Players may only have one Hand on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Holy Retribution
Holy Shield
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Increases chance to block by 30% for 10 sec and deals 79 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active.  Each block expends a charge.  8 charges.

abilities.name: Light of Justice
Righteous Defense
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Come to the defense of a friendly target, commanding up to 3 enemies attacking the target to attack the Paladin instead.

This spell can not miss.

abilities.name: Righteous Fury
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Increases threat generated by 75%. Doubled for holy spells and abilities.

abilities.name: Seal of Justice
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Fills the Paladin with the spirit of justice for 30 min, giving each melee attack a chance to stun for 2 sec.  Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will deal 1 Holy damage to an enemy.

abilities.name: Shadow Resistance Aura
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Gives 60 additional Shadow resistance to all party and raid members within 40 yards.  Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Shield of Righteousness
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Slam the target with your shield, causing Holy damage based on your block value plus an additional 143.

abilities.name: Avenging Wrath
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Increases all damage and healing caused by 20% for 20 sec.  Cannot be used within 30 sec of being the target of Divine Shield, Divine Protection, or Hand of Protection, or of using Lay on Hands on oneself.

abilities.name: Blessing of Might
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Bless all members of the raid or group with a Sanctified Blessing of Might, increasing attack power by 232 for 30 min.  Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Crusader Aura
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Increases the mounted speed by 20% for all party and raid members within 40 yards.  Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.  This does not stack with other movement speed increasing effects.

abilities.name: Crusader Strike
abilities.tooltipTemplate: An instant strike that causes 75% weapon damage.

abilities.name: Divine Storm
abilities.tooltipTemplate: An instant weapon attack that causes 110% of weapon damage to up to 4 enemies within 8 yards.  The Divine Storm heals up to 3 party or raid members totaling 25% of the damage caused.

abilities.name: Hammer of Wrath
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Hurls a hammer that strikes an enemy for 570 to 628 Holy damage.  Only usable on enemies that have 20% or less health.

abilities.name: Judgement of Justice
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Unleashes the energy of a Seal spell to judge an enemy for 20 sec, preventing them from fleeing and limiting their movement speed.  Refer to individual Seals for additional Judgement effect.  Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

abilities.name: Judgement of Light
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Unleashes the energy of a Seal spell to judge an enemy for 20 sec, granting attacks made against the judged enemy a chance of healing the attacker for 2% of their maximum health.  Refer to individual Seals for additional Judgement effect.  Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

abilities.name: Judgement of Wisdom
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Unleashes the energy of a Seal spell to judge an enemy for 20 sec, giving each attack a chance to restore 2% of the attacker's base mana.  Refer to individual Seals for additional Judgement effect.  Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

abilities.name: Retribution Aura
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Causes 48 Holy damage to any enemy that strikes a party or raid member within 40 yards.  Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

abilities.name: Seal of Command
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
All melee attacks deal 0 to 0 additional Holy damage.  When used with attacks or abilities that strike a single target, this additional Holy damage will strike up to 2 additional targets.  Lasts 30 min.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 0 to 0 Holy damage.

abilities.name: Seal of Vengeance
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Fills the Paladin with holy power, causing auto attacks and Hammer of the Righteous to apply Holy Vengeance, which deals 0 additional Holy damage over 15 sec.  Holy Vengeance can stack up to 5 times.  Once stacked to 5 times, each of the Paladin's attacks also deals 33% weapon damage as additional Holy damage.  Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.  Lasts 30 min.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will deal 1 Holy damage to an enemy, increased by 10% for each application of Holy Vengeance on the target.
